newsitem.title: USA: MedPartners to offer $350 mln of TAPS.
newsitem.headline: MedPartners to offer $350 mln of TAPS.

text.p: MedPartners Inc said Wednesday it will offer up to $350 million of threshold appreciation price securities, or TAPS.
The company said the TAPS will bear semi-annual payments and, upon the final settlement date in July, 2000, will be settled for a number of shares of common stock of the company.

The number of shares at settlement will be determined based on the price of MedPartners common stock at that time, it said. The company will receive proceeds from the issuance of the TAPS at the final settlement date.
MedPartners also said it intends to offer up to $350 million in senior subordinated notes.
The notes will mature and become due in July, 2000, at about the time the company receives the proceeds from the TAPS issuance, it said.

MedPartners said it plans to use the proceeds of the offering for general corporate purposes, which may include repayment of debt, capital expenditures, acquisitions, investments in subsidiaries, working capital and other business opportunities.
